_: Nature's Spirit's sandy soil wears as dirt: the mod tags it dirt, and the rules refuse it by the word soil, which keeps worked ground out. Chert and travertine, the rock of its biomes, wear as stone: neither name carries a word the rules read as rock. The rest of the mod is detection's where detection places it.

From the modded census of 26.1.2 (W4 R12, judged 2026-11-13), named one by one, only the blocks that census judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Stone: kaolin and its brown, light gray, white and yellow kaolins are the natural clay rock of its badlands, as terracotta is; white chalk is natural sedimentary rock, as Regions Unexplored's chalk is; pink sandstone is natural rock, as vanilla sandstone is; all are rock with no stone word or a decorative one. Grass: the red moss block is a moss block, as vanilla's is grass, on a material no rule reads. The bricks, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged, nor the red moss carpet, and they are left to the rules; smooth pink sandstone was excluded as made.

Stone, judged in the same census in W4 R13 (2026-11-13): the other twelve colors of kaolin and the other fifteen of chalk, which that census did not find as open ground. Each is the same natural rock as its judged colors, and a dye color does not change what the ground is, so each is stone as they are; no other edition's census has the mod's kaolin or chalk, and the director ruled every color the family of its judged ones.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 26.1.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
